cc:Work.dc:title: Interpreting one-day 95% Value at Risk
cc:Work.dc:description: An illustrative normal profit-and-loss distribution with a dashed cutoff at minus one million dollars. Reported 95 percent VaR is positive one million dollars. The hatched left tail contains five percent of probability and continues beyond the plotted range.
